note: Public official websites an officer can use to check a document manually. They need no API or registration; most use captchas and must be checked by a person. Links were confirmed to resolve on 2026-10-24 (some block automated requests but open normally in a browser).

sources.name: AICTE Approved Institutes dashboard
sources.how: Open 'Approved Institutes', choose the academic year, state and institution type, then search by name or Permanent ID. Compare approval status, courses and intake.

sources.name: SHCIL e-Stamp certificate verification
sources.how: Use 'Verify e-Stamp Certificate' with the certificate number, issue date and stamp duty printed on the e-stamp paper.

sources.name: UGC university lists
sources.how: Check the lists of recognised universities and of fake universities for the affiliating or awarding university.

sources.name: NAAC accreditation status
sources.how: Search accredited institutions for the grade, cycle and validity period.

sources.name: NBA accredited programmes
sources.how: Search accredited programmes by institution for the programme name and accreditation validity.

sources.name: NIRF rankings
sources.how: Confirm a ranking claimed in a document (e.g. for collaboration programmes).

sources.name: MCA company master data
sources.how: Use 'Master Data' → 'View Company or LLP Master Data' with the CIN to confirm a Section 8 company's name, status and registered office.

sources.name: GST taxpayer search
sources.how: Search by GSTIN to confirm the legal name and registration status of the trust/society/company.

sources.name: Income Tax e-filing — verify PAN status
sources.how: Use 'Verify Your PAN' under Quick Links to confirm the PAN of the managing body matches its name.

sources.name: DigiLocker
sources.how: Documents issued into DigiLocker carry the issuer's digital signature; ask the institution to share the original DigiLocker document and check its signature here.

sources.name: State fire, municipal and land-records portals
sources.how: Fire NOCs, occupancy/completion certificates and land records are verified on the issuing state department's portal (for example the state land-records site). APH 2024-27 Annexure-14 lists the competent authority for each state.
